export function walk(xs: number[]): number {
  let n = 0;
  for (const x of xs) {
    if (x > 0) {
      while (n < x) {
        if (n % 2 === 0) {
          n += 1;
        }
        n += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return n;
}

export function step(xs: number[]): number {
  let n = 0;
  for (const x of xs) {
    if (x > 0) {
      if (x > 10) {
        n += x;
      } else if (x > 5) {
        n -= x;
      } else {
        n += 1;
      }
    }
  }
  return n;
}

export const collect = (xs: number[]): number[] =>
  xs.map(function (x) {
    for (const a of [x]) {
      for (const b of [a]) {
        for (const c of [b]) {
          if (c > 0) {
            return c;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return 0;
  });

export function wire(view: unknown, id: number): void {
  render(view, true);
  load(id, false, 3);
  setOpen(true);
  expect(view).toBe(false);
  expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(54, true);
}
